name: Photon pulse laser
specs: 5 dmg · 22 km · 0.4 s cycle · 2 heat/s · pulse
flavour: Every hull leaves the yard with one. There is a reason.

name: Photon intermittent laser
specs: 13 dmg · 26 km · 1 s cycle · 4 heat/s · intermittent
flavour: Hits harder, waits longer. Patience in a housing.

name: Photon beam laser
specs: 2 dmg · 30 km · 0.12 s cycle · 12 heat/s · beam
flavour: Reaches as far as you can aim it. Light does not get tired.

name: Pion pulse accelerator
specs: 20 dmg · 11 km · 0.4 s cycle · 5 heat/s · pulse
flavour: Devastating in a knife fight. Bring a knife.

name: Pion intermittent accelerator
specs: 52 dmg · 13 km · 1 s cycle · 9 heat/s · intermittent
flavour: Fifty-two points, if you are close enough to regret it.

name: Kaon beam accelerator
specs: 8 dmg · 15 km · 0.12 s cycle · 26 heat/s · beam
flavour: Strips a shield like old paint. You will have to get close.

name: Muon pulse accelerator
specs: 24 dmg · 34 km · 0.4 s cycle · 11 heat/s · pulse
flavour: Reach without apology. Bring a reactor and a firm opinion.

name: Mining laser
specs: 1 dmg · 3 km · 0.12 s cycle · 8 heat/s · beam
flavour: Cuts rock, not ships. Hold it steady and bring a scoop.

name: Mining laser cannon
specs: 12 dmg · 5 km · 3 s cycle · 10 heat/s · pulse
flavour: Knocks a piece off the face from five kilometres. Give the capacitors their three seconds.

name: Muon intermittent accelerator
specs: 62 dmg · 40 km · 1 s cycle · 18 heat/s · intermittent
flavour: Sixty-two points, once a second, from further than they can answer.

name: Muon beam accelerator
specs: 9 dmg · 46 km · 0.16 s cycle · 45 heat/s · beam
flavour: If it is still there after four seconds, check your aim — not the gun.

name: Mass driver
specs: 30 dmg · 25 km · 1.6 s cycle · 3 heat/s · kinetic
flavour: Half of it the shield never sees. Lead them, mind the kick, and buy slugs by the tonne.

name: Bootleg intermittent laser
specs: 13 dmg · 24 km · 1 s cycle · 8 heat/s · intermittent
flavour: Same thirteen points as the certified one. Runs twice as hot and sometimes just does not.

name: Salvaged pion accelerator
specs: 20 dmg · 10 km · 0.4 s cycle · 11 heat/s · pulse
flavour: Twenty points off a wreck, at a bit over half list. It will cook you and it will let you down, and it is still twenty points.

name: Syndicate-issue beam accelerator
specs: 9 dmg · 46 km · 0.16 s cycle · 45 heat/s · beam
flavour: The same gun the enforcement wing flies. Nobody asks where the serial numbers went.

name: Auto-turret
flavour: Buyable disinterest. Point the ship anywhere you like.

name: Shroud suite
flavour: Not on any list. Neither are you, while it runs.

name: ECM jammer
flavour: Makes a seeker doubt itself. Runs hot doing it.

name: Shield generator
flavour: Forty points of somebody else’s problem. Refills itself if you let it.

name: Restricted-space transponder
flavour: Answers the challenge nobody civilian is supposed to hear. Where it lets you go is not a reward.

name: Habitation unit
flavour: Four berths, a galley and a scrubber. Eight tonnes of hold becomes four people who expect to arrive.

name: Forged transponder
flavour: Answers the challenge in somebody else's name. Not every challenger is satisfied.

name: Ablative heat shield
flavour: Rated for atmospheric entry. Increasingly popular with beam crews.

name: Heat sink launcher
flavour: Three chances to fire for longer than your hull agrees with.

name: Decoy launcher
flavour: Twelve hot little lies, fired aft. Best told at the last second.

name: Hull scanner
flavour: Tells you how badly they are hurt. Not how much they can take.

name: Combat scanner
flavour: Hull and shields, in numbers. Knowing is most of winning.

name: Combat analyser
flavour: Hull, shields, and what they would point at you. Looking is not shooting.

name: Market survey array
flavour: Every warehouse in the system, sorted by who is desperate.

name: Trade analyser
flavour: One port, its month on a graph, and what a run costs you in fuel.

name: Survey scanner
flavour: Grade 1. Ore, ice and hydrogen, poor or rich. Blind to anything rarer.

name: Gamma survey spectrometer
flavour: Grade 2. Adds the fissiles - they give themselves away.

name: Deep survey array
flavour: Grade 3. Rare metals too, and the tonnage. The Guild pays for numbers.

name: Gas skimmer intake
flavour: A ram scoop. Point the nose into the top of a giant and the hold fills. Fly it lower and so does the coroner.

name: Cargo scoop
flavour: Catches whatever you can fly gently enough to catch.

name: Auxiliary reactor Mk I
flavour: Two and a half more megawatts. Five tonnes. Your call.

name: Auxiliary reactor Mk II
flavour: The upgrade most pilots make twice: once too late, once correctly.

name: Auxiliary reactor Mk III
flavour: Fourteen tonnes of yes. Check your fit tonnage before you sign.

name: Wake Baffle I
flavour: What you leave at the mouth of a jump, smeared until it is not worth reading.

name: Wake Baffle II
flavour: What you leave at the mouth of a jump, smeared until it is not worth reading.

name: Wake Baffle IV
flavour: What you leave at the mouth of a jump, smeared until it is not worth reading.

name: Harmonic Transit Anchor I
flavour: The cheap opportunist stops being able to touch you. The serious one still can.

flavour: Half the corridor. It will not take hydrogen, and what it leaves in your hold is nobody's idea of clean.

name: Cruise Drive Class 1
flavour: What every hull leaves the yard with.

name: Military Cruise Drive Class 1
flavour: Five times the speed of its class while it has milfuel to burn, and waste in the hold for every slug. Without slugs it runs as an ordinary drive.

name: Cruise Drive Class 2
flavour: Twice the speed of the class below it, between the planets.

name: Military Cruise Drive Class 2
flavour: Five times the speed of its class while it has milfuel to burn, and waste in the hold for every slug. Without slugs it runs as an ordinary drive.

name: Cruise Drive Class 3
flavour: Twice the speed of the class below it, between the planets.

name: Military Cruise Drive Class 3
flavour: Five times the speed of its class while it has milfuel to burn, and waste in the hold for every slug. Without slugs it runs as an ordinary drive.

name: Hawk seeker
flavour: Fire and forget. Mostly forget.

name: Bootleg seeker
flavour: Sold by the crate, no questions, no paperwork and no guarantee it leaves the rail.

name: Guild rock torpedo
flavour: Serial-numbered. Take it out, set it off, bring back the log - not the torpedo.

name: Unregistered rock charge
flavour: Same yield, no serial. Nobody refunds what nobody logged.

name: Decoy charge
flavour: Hot, bright, and not you.

name: Heat sink charge
flavour: Ablative mass, one use. Comes back out glowing and stays that way.

name: Driver slugs (1 t)
flavour: Twenty-five kilos each. You will feel every one leave.

name: Talon Courier
flavour: the ship you started with, and honestly not bad

name: Dart Interceptor
flavour: outruns everything; carries nothing

name: Kestrel Multirole
flavour: the compromise, made well

name: Mule Freighter
flavour: slow, vast, and worth robbing

name: Wren Shuttle
flavour: the cheapest way off a planet

name: Bollard Tug
flavour: all engine and fenders

name: Samaritan Tender
flavour: built to survive somebody else's fight

name: Sump Waste Hauler
flavour: cheap hold, because of what usually goes in it

name: Longhaul Freighter
flavour: the freighter on every lane

name: Coldwater Tanker
flavour: goes further than anything else on the list

name: Naval Cutter
flavour: the navy's own, sold to the navy's friends

name: Meridian Liner
flavour: a passenger city with a drive

name: Leviathan Bulk Carrier
flavour: the biggest thing at the dock

name: Capital Ship
flavour: the thing everybody else runs from

name: Crawler
flavour: carries a station to where it will stand

name: Hawser Heavy Tug
flavour: two arms and the shoulders to use them

name: Heron Heavy Shuttle
flavour: a shuttle with a freighter's hold

name: Tallyman Trader
flavour: the merchant on every short run

name: Corsair Runner
flavour: fast enough to choose her fights

name: Syndicate Enforcer
flavour: the mob's patrol ship

name: Syndicate Heavy
flavour: bolted-on armour and four guns

name: Lance Fighter
flavour: a carrier's strike wing, one seat at a time

name: Fleet Carrier
flavour: a city that can leave

name: Slipway
flavour: where hulls are built — the heart of a shipyard

name: Skimmer rig
flavour: scoops and tanks for a gas giant's upper air

name: Refinery line
flavour: turns ore and hydrogen into something worth more

name: Ore works
flavour: crushers and a receiving bay for mining traffic

name: Market hall
flavour: a trade floor: the station buys and sells

name: Hab ring
flavour: quarters and a concourse: passengers come and go

name: Warehouse
flavour: deep storage behind the market

name: Repair dock
flavour: hull repairs for whoever docks

name: Reactor pile
flavour: more power for a bigger station

name: Crew quarters
flavour: bunks for the people who run the place

name: Berth clamp
flavour: one more clamp for traffic

name: Defence battery
flavour: guns that answer when somebody shoots at the station

name: Comms relay
flavour: prices and news arrive sooner

name: Fuel cell
flavour: a reactor that can go longer between deliveries
